svg.text: Database bar_management_db - 21 tables - Umucyo Bar (Bar Stock, Sales and Business Management System)
PK = primary key FK = foreign key UQ = unique lines run from the "many" side (N, the table holding the FK) to the "one" side (1)
One user records many transactions (not drawn, to keep the diagram readable)
purchases: created_by, confirmed_by, cancelled_by; cash_sessions: opened_by, closed_by
sales: sold_by, discount_by, cancelled_by; payments: received_by; debt_payments: received_by; expenses: recorded_by
stock_adjustments: adjusted_by; stock_movements: created_by; cash_transactions: recorded_by; audit_logs: user_id
Each of these columns references users.id (N : 1)
